personality: 6 Glass / Luxe (with structural elements from 7 Dark-First Utility)
personality_one_liner: A premium, cinematic 3D grooming studio that balances glassmorphism luxury with the precise utility of a professional design tool.

spacing.rule: Generous luxury spacing. Avoid dense layouts unless inside the bottom sheet editor controls where utility takes precedence.

do's: Use heavy glassmorphism for floating controls overlaid on the 3D avatar viewport (Header, View toggles, Bottom chip bar).
Apply translucent tinted base (≥75% of surfaceSecondary) beneath blur in dark mode to ensure contrast.
Use frosted glass on sticky headers over scrolling style grids.
dont's: Do not blur dense form fields or sliders inside the bottom sheet.
Do not use glass for the main screen background.

screens.name: Style Library (Home)
screens.purpose: Browsing 60+ ready-made styles to use as a base before entering the 3D editor.
screens.layout: Sticky glass top header with 'Men/Women' segmented control. Horizontal scrolling filter pills (length, face shape). Below: 2-column masonry or even grid of style cards. Each card has a subtle gradient overlay (scrim) for title readability and a 'Favorite' icon.

states.loading: Centered premium gold spinner over dark background.
states.empty: No styles found. 'Reset filters' primary CTA.

screens.name: 3D Avatar Editor
screens.purpose: The core manipulation workspace for inspecting and customizing haircut parts.
screens.layout: Full-bleed black/ambient canvas. Top header is floating glass (Back, Save, Undo/Redo). Right edge: vertical stack of floating glass FABs for Quick Views (Front, Side, Back, Top) and Lighting. Bottom edge: floating horizontal glass rail of 'Region Chips' (Top, Fringe, Sides, etc.). Tapping a region brings up the Editor Bottom Sheet.

states.loading: Skeleton model or loading bar overlaying the canvas.
states.error: Canvas failed to initialize. Reload button.

screens.name: Editor Controls (Bottom Sheet)
screens.purpose: Granular parameter adjustments for the selected hair region.
screens.layout: Full modal sheet via @gorhom/bottom-sheet. Uses solid surfaceSecondary (not glass). Contains large touch-friendly sliders for Length/Fade, segmented controls for Texture/Volume, and horizontal color swatches. Sticky 'Apply' or 'Close' CTA at the bottom.

screens.name: Avatar Setup / Gallery
screens.purpose: Selecting a base head model (skin tone, face shape) to preview styles on.
screens.layout: Carousel (horizontal scroll with paging) of 4-6 large avatar head previews. A primary 'Select & Continue' CTA sticky at bottom.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: Arabic (RTL) is the default language. Implement React Native's I18nManager.forceRTL(true) properly to ensure the UI mirrors correctly. English is secondary.
Use Cairo for headings and IBM Plex Sans Arabic for body text to ensure high legibility in both RTL and LTR.

Implement the 3D Viewer screen using expo-gl and three.js. Create a mock interactive 3D object (e.g., stylized head/sphere) if a complex head model isn't available, but ensure drag-to-rotate, pinch-to-zoom, and quick views (camera angle changes) are functional.
Use heavy glassmorphism for UI elements floating over the 3D canvas (Quick Views FABs, Region Chip Bar, Top Navigation) to create a premium cinematic feel.
Do NOT use indigo, blue, or purple. The theme relies on Midnight Black (#0A0A0A) surfaces with Antique Gold/Amber (#D4A373 / #E5A93C) as the premium accent color.
Always apply a dark-to-transparent scrim (gradient) behind text overlaying images in the Style Library grid to ensure AA accessibility contrast.
Ensure all touch targets inside the Editor Bottom Sheet (sliders, toggles, chips) are large (≥44pt) and thumb-friendly.
